Which factor explains this difference?
The atomic radius of an oxygen atom is smaller than that of fluorine.

options.A: The covalent bond in a fluorine molecule is weaker than the bond in an oxygen molecule.
options.B: A spin-paired electron is removed from fluorine but not from oxygen.
options.C: Fluorine has more electrons in total than oxygen. This causes a greater shielding of the nuclear attraction in fluorine.
